answer.generated: The effective access time for this TLB setup can be calculated using the weighted average of the hit and miss scenarios. Given a 98% hit rate, the remaining 2% corresponds to cache misses. The formula to determine the effective access time is (0.98 * 20 ns) + (0.02 * 320 ns), which simplifies to 19.6 ns + 6.4 ns, resulting in an effective access time of 26 ns. This calculation reflects the average time taken to access the TLB, accounting for both successful and unsuccessful translation attempts.
